raw_text: CabinZero Classic 36L Cabin Backpack. Travel light. Travel far. The Classic 36L is the original CabinZero: a simple, ultra-light cabin bag designed to make travel stress-free. Weighing just 760 g, it is one of the lightest cabin bags in the world — you pack the weight, not the bag. Dimensions: 44 x 30 x 24 cm, sized to fit within most airline carry-on allowances, including easyJet large cabin bags and British Airways hand luggage, and it clears Ryanair's priority cabin bag sizer with room to spare.
